status: Read-only preparation for recommended O11-1/F08 local control/project/batch business. No implementation or runtime acceptance claim; no parallel plan.
safety_scope: Selected original source/header/Designer/schema definitions only. Never opened production database/configuration, credentials, prohibited public/systemcommon.cpp; never instantiated, built or ran reference or product GUI.

entry_and_role_contract.compile_entry: SeeRain450.pro includes frm_quality/frm_quality.pri at130; it is not a commented/unenabled task/formula entry.
entry_and_role_contract.main_entry: frmMain unconditionally constructs frmQuality, inserts it at main index4, registers the Quality button at4 and connects menu group directly to setCurrentIndex. Static selected source has no SN100-specific exclusion.

visible_actions.main_btnEditControl: set batch -> MaskDlgControlBatchSetting for selected control ID
visible_actions.main_btnPrint: created/styled but explicitly hidden in init_component; not a printing acceptance claim

entry_and_role_contract.roles: No role/identity/connection check found in selected QC add/edit/project/batch handlers. Original logout/user-change wiring refreshes account/driver/system/reagent (and calibration login hookup), not a QC role slot. Do not invent an admin/engineer-only ACL from numeric IDs; preserve the unified existing account session and record any deliberate new restriction separately.
entry_and_role_contract.limits: Code-level enabled entry is established, but actual deployed SN100 Windows edition/configuration/active theme/role behavior remains unverified. No production configuration was read.

schema_and_reference_facts.control: quality_control_list.item_name globally NOT NULL UNIQUE; is_used and factor_name NOT NULL. New control source explicitly sets used=true. Main page filters used; management lists all.
schema_and_reference_facts.association: quality_item_proj links item_id to control ID and stores proj_name string. It has no source-declared composite uniqueness or FK. UI uses multi-selection to add and remove project associations.
schema_and_reference_facts.result_metadata: quality_rules.item_proj_id points to association; source fields include ResultType/name/used,6 string-valued target/bound/SD fields and9 strategies. No batch_id exists here: targets/rules are not stored per batch in this source schema.

result_type_scope.creation: Original manager creates metadata only for source-used types kOriginal..kINR (1..4), not all possible result types.

schema_and_reference_facts.strategies: 9 integer fields map to kUncheck0/kWaring1/kFinish2. The source names/typos (r5_5s vs widget cbx_r5_05s etc.) are not proof of accepted rule meaning. Preserve metadata; do not enable clinical rule evaluation.
schema_and_reference_facts.batch: quality_control_batch.fid is control ID; batch_name is globally UNIQUE, not UNIQUE(fid,batch_name). Dates serialize yyyy/MM/dd. Source does not constrain current/previous flags or enforce per-control uniqueness of those flags.
schema_and_reference_facts.history: quality_data links by control_name/project_name/control_batch strings, not control/project/batch IDs. Column name is result_val while C++ member is result_value. Rename/delete policies must protect existing history and not silently orphan chart queries.
schema_and_reference_facts.daily_upsert: Original upAddQualityData searches the name/project/batch/date tuple, updates the first existing row or inserts. The table source declares no unique tuple; result_val is a serialized multi-value string, not automatically one row per measured point.
schema_and_reference_facts.sql_scope: These are C++ source schema definitions, not inspection of a deployed production database. No FK/ON DELETE/current-batch uniqueness declarations were found in the five table sources; base DeleteWithId removes only the selected table row.
schema_and_reference_facts.storage_decision_before_coding: Choose explicit isolated tagged SQLite ownership and existing ProjectsStore reference strategy. If extending catalog.db, freeze schema upgrade/rollback and same-file FK/worker rules; if using separate DB, do not pretend cross-file logical references are SQLite FKs or atomic with the project store.

original_operations_and_validation.control_add: QualityControlAdd requires nonempty control name and manufacturer, caller requests Head_Letter_Num length16 for both; exact shared validator implementation not read. Confirm stores directly set used=true. Upper manager Save updates name/manufacturer plus selected result-rule metadata sequentially.
original_operations_and_validation.control_valid_checkbox: ckxValid is rendered from item.used and labelled valid, but inspected Save does not assign its state back to control_item and there is no dedicated signal handler. Editable used-state is an original implementation gap, not already proven working behavior.
original_operations_and_validation.projects: Chooser lists all original project parameters with multi-selection and initially selects existing names. Confirm removes unchecked associations and creates new association plus used result metadata types1..4. New association/rules creation is not a single source transaction; BulkInsert itself iterates steps without a transaction.
original_operations_and_validation.target_editor: Original numeric-validator caller passes min0/max9999/4 decimals for six target/bounds/SD strings. Save lacks a full final relation/clinical check. No target/SD/limits or rule efficacy defaults should be invented.
original_operations_and_validation.batch_add: Original Add requires batch-name/date nonempty; batch name validator caller length32. QDate::fromString yyyy/MM/dd is used without a subsequent validity check. First batch becomes current, previous=false; later batches both flags=false.
original_operations_and_validation.batch_remove: Selected batch ID is deleted immediately and list/default selection reloads. No history/dependency guard or full group transaction is established by source.
original_operations_and_validation.manager_cancel: Manager Close/Cancel only closes it; previously committed Add/Delete/project/default actions are not undone. It is different from discarding still-uncommitted name/target text.
original_operations_and_validation.project_chooser_cancel_bug: Bottom cancel sets isClose=true and prevents caller mutation. Top X clears selection and closes without setting isClose, so caller may treat it as confirm-empty and unlink all projects. Both new cancel paths must mean no mutation, recorded as safety correction.

default_batch_contract.UpdataFlag: Updates only the specified row's cur_batch/prv_batch booleans; caller coordinates multiple rows. It does not scope/validate fid or enforce one current/previous. SQLITE_DONE alone does not prove a matching row existed.
explicit_user_switch_sequence: New current=N and previous=old C; selecting old P therefore swaps the meaningful current/previous roles.
default_batch_contract.local_migration_action: Preserve the original explicitly named default-combo user action as an immediate queued worker transaction if desired; no extra Save button is required. Suppress writes during programmatic render/load and give actual success/failure feedback with selection rollback.
atomic_invariants: Selected batch must exist and belong to selected control before clearing any flags.
Current and previous must be distinct and within same fid; at most one of each per declared scope.
Same selected/current ID is a no-op.
All clear/demote/promote changes commit or rollback together, checking affected rows.
Opening/refreshing a view must not silently repair persisted state or choose an arbitrary unordered row.
default_batch_contract.load_side_effect_and_old_defect: Both management/batch loaders promote previous to current when no current exists, but do not synchronize cached cur/prv IDs afterward; first combo item may not be that promoted record. Multiple current flags also collapse to last-loaded UI choice without repairing DB. Do not copy this implicit repair behavior.
default_batch_contract.deletion_policy_to_freeze: Keep source global batch-name uniqueness unless an intentional compatibility change is approved. Define safe current/previous/history-referenced deletion, rather than letting load-time repair guess a new default.

source_defects_to_separate_from_intended: Main control list filters is_used but subsequent row index reads unfiltered quality_items_; bind QListWidget/UserRole stable IDs, not filtered row index.
Editing/deleting control by display row and renaming history name keys can misassociate or hide old points; define ID/reference-safe policy.
Top-X project chooser cancellation can unlink all projects, unlike bottom Cancel.
Unchecking adjacent project rows removes while iterating forward and may skip one; apply an ID-set diff atomically.
Deleting a control/association via base DeleteWithId has no demonstrated cascade/history cleanup. Preserve referenced data or reject safely; no silent orphaning.
Association insert followed by rule bulk inserts and control Save followed by rule Save can partially commit. Use one worker transaction per advertised action.
ckxValid persistence is not wired in original Save despite its visible label; explicitly decide/document safe local completion or truthful disabled behavior.
Do not call legacy SqlBase.setSqlString(SystemCommon::mysqlConnectString) or original global table singletons from new GUI; use explicit anonymous root and owned worker connections.
Do not include the original frm_quality.pri wholesale to obtain layout: it also pulls rule algorithm/chart/parser. Keep unvalidated rule execution and clinical result effects isolated.
visual_limit: Designer root dimensions are logical source geometry, not an executed dialog/window measurement. Keep original groups/colors/control order and runtime style dependencies; verify actual1600x900/1920 reachability with mask/dialog behavior and justify only necessary font/scale/scroll adaptation. Original active Windows theme/RK remains unverified.

do_now_after_lis_freeze: Port original main4 frame, manager/add/project-selector/batch forms with store injection.
Actual control add/edit/delete, project/result selection and batch add/delete/default switch, tagged anonymous persistence, stable IDs and transactions.
Preserve source fields/constraints and exact enum IDs; make source defects/safety differences explicit.
Attach to unified main4 only after independent local pass; old pages cumulative, lifecycle, applicable platform/package and response/resource evidence follow.
proposed_offline_slices_not_parallel_pla.not_waiting_on: Real curves, clot endpoint algorithm, calibration fitting, LIS endpoint or physical instrument.

proposed_offline_slices_not_parallel_pla.slice: QC local2 anonymous historical point/curve browsing
independent_inputs: Explicit anonymous control/project/batch/date/time/result_val fixtures with frozen parser/units/ordering.
Source-aware raw value parsing with invalid/missing values preserved, never fabricated as zero.
Display current/previous batch traces and validated pure statistics only; clinical/out-of-control status stays unvalidated.
proposed_offline_slices_not_parallel_pla.not_waiting_on: New physical acquisition or acceptance of clinical rule algorithm.
proposed_offline_slices_not_parallel_pla.parser_caution: Original getRuleValue splits on '-' and discards empty tokens; negative/scientific/malformed strings and ordering need explicit tests before reusing it.

start_only_when: Confirmed rule/window/bounds/CV-unit semantics and original Windows baseline.
Real measurement/calibration/result identity and approved instrument/endpoint scope.

minimum_anonymous_acceptance_matrix: Control/manufacturer nonempty/length/control-character/Unicode validation, duplicate name, rename and reopen; stable IDs with hidden/visible control rows.
Project multi-select add/unlink/confirm versus both cancel paths; duplicate association, result type IDs1..4, supported/unknown project/result/unit reference guards.
All source batch fields roundtrip; global duplicate batch-name across two controls, invalid/expired dates with declared local policy, first batch default only by explicit creation action.
Current/previous switch, same-batch no-op, selecting previous, missing/foreign batch ID, zero/multiple flags, delete-current/previous/history reference, full rollback on middle-step failure.
Actual SQLite busy/write/commit/conflict failures, original bytes/rows unchanged where rejected, GUI draft/selection retained and successful retry.
Opening/refreshing dialogs and canceling must not make implicit DB writes; callbacks carry value IDs/snapshots, not QWidget/QListWidgetItem pointers into worker.
Busy/draft guards across dialog close, main navigation, login/logout/normal exit; shared store worker ownership and no real task/transport actions.
Original visual controls/actual mouse/keyboard reachability and page4 final attach; pure layout or direct click() alone is not the full workflow.
New slice independently passes then immediate unified cumulative validation, fresh build/package freeze and resource evidence; do not call hardware/rules/clinical QC completed.
resource_phase_obedience: This preparation runs no persistent helper/background task. Stop all remaining reads/hashes immediately when root starts isolated resource measurements.
